verses.pali: “Āsevitabbañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṁ desessāmi na āsevitabbañca.
verses.english: “I will teach you the principle to cultivate and the principle not to cultivate. …

verses.pali: katamo ca, bhikkhave, na āsevitabbo dhammo?
verses.english: And what is the principle not to cultivate?
Wrong view, wrong purpose, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, wrong immersion, wrong knowledge, and wrong freedom.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, na āsevitabbo dhammo.
verses.english: This is called the principle not to cultivate.
And what is the principle to cultivate?
Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.
This is called the principle to cultivate.”
